notes.title: Small bugfix released
notes.content: We've pushed a small bugfix that corrects a late-game issue with quest progression. Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Fundraising begins for upcoming OTUSUN LAND projects!
notes.content:
The time has come! As previewed in our previous post, we've just begun our fundraising campaign to support the development of upcoming projects, mainly the next major Hippoboar Rancher update and the spinoff visual novel starting Siris!

The whole thing's taking place over at the [url=https://hippoboar.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders]Hippoboar Rancher BackerKit page[/url].

[url=https://hippoboar.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302115/9e32cd54835a3c3dd996ea26d60267356aec6ad5.png[/img][/url]
Check out all the cool new stuff we have in store!

What's more, any purchase from this page, including a Tip Jar donation, will get you access to the new OTUSUN LAND Discord server, where we'll be sharing exclusive previews of upcoming games and updates - plus for you Nitro users, we have tons of cute hippoboar stickers for you to use in your other servers. We'll begin sending out access for supporters a little later this month!

As far as shipping goes, shipping costs are a flat $5 for any US order of any size, and a flat $20 for any international order of any size. We realize international shipping is expensive, but unfortunately this is the best international shipping price possible from the US at this time. We plan to start shipping orders by early October at latest!

Please do note that there's no funding goal or necessary amount here - we'll be releasing the upcoming update and Siris spin-off even if we don't sell a single item, but your support will go a long way towards helping it happen much sooner, so please take a look and consider telling your friends!

Feel free to let us know in the comments if you have any questions or issues with the new merch, and thanks as always for your support!

notes.title: Untitled
notes.content:
Hello to all ranchers! We're gearing up for the next major Hippoboar Rancher content update - and we need your help to do it! We didn't want to "lock" the update behind a crowdfunding campaign goal, though, so we're going to be doing things a little differently this time: we'll be setting up a merch storefront to offer goodies directly to you, which will help us fund the development and localization of the update, which will of course be free to all owners of the game!

We'll be launching this storefront this Friday, and we'll have a wide array of dope swag available - here's a little peek!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302115/f58eb4ae9219556ad56ac37e54f55e609e81b855.png[/img]
Tote bags!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302115/839e04b55ba4f8a25f47febb15a3c59c699f80f1.png[/img]
And playing cards!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302115/62cbcc69abbbc22a6326ffe6fcbf0344990a2384.png[/img]
And t-shirts, oh my!
This is just a small sample of what we'll have available - we'll also have enamel pins, cloth masks, and much more!

What's more, if you follow OTUSUN CLUB's Japanese accounts, you might know that development is underway on a Hippoboar Rancher spinoff visual novel, a romance story starring Siris. Well, we'll of course be releasing this in English as well, and the fundraising campaign will also help make that possible sooner! We look forward to your support!

Between the Hippoboar Rancher update and the above-mentioned spin-off, the rest of 2021 is pretty packed for us, but come 2022, we hope to turn our sights towards finally offering The Bell Chimes for Gold sequel nEroErosso in English, as well as continuing the development of Neighbor follow-up Carrion Crow, so stick around!

notes.title: First major content update released!
notes.content:
Howdy, ranchers! We hope you've been enjoying your time playing Hippoboar Rancher!

As promised, we've continued working on regular updates for the game, and the first major one has just been released! It features a ton of new content: new characters and quests, a new, in-depth tutorial, new livestock, new hippoboar breeds, and more! See below for the full patch notes!

We hope you'll enjoy diving back into your ranch, and we'd love to see how much profit and clout you've amassed! Please show off how much you've grown your ranches here on Steam, or on Twitter with the hashtag #HippoboarRancher - we'll be on the lookout for them!

We also wanted to let you know that we're going to be starting a crowdfunding campaign for our next title, a localization of OTUSUN CLUB's [b]MariAlbum[/b]! [b]MariAlbum[/b] is an adult otome romance title and a spinoff of OTUSUN's flagship title, The Bell Chimes For Gold. You may have even seen some of the characters in [b]MariAlbum[/b] mentioned in passing during your ranching exploits! You can preview the campaign [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/otusunland/985471107?ref=5axot9&token=620b6aff]here[/url] before it goes live on October 1. We're looking forward to your support!

notes.title: Soundtrack released & merch available!
notes.content:
We hope you've all been enjoying playing Hippoboar Rancher! We have a bit of news to share with you today: the soundtrack for the game is now available to purchase on Steam!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1289360/Hippoboar_Rancher__Original_Soundtrack/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1289360/ss_9e627c1addf1e3f2f15a8dc3395465942a923eb2.1920x1080.jpg[/img][/url]

Click on the image above or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1289360/Hippoboar_Rancher__Original_Soundtrack/]right here[/url] to check it out!

What's more, we also have a limited number of [url=https://otusun.booth.pm/items/1943823]soundtrack CDs[/url] available for purchase from our Booth site, as well as a variety of other merch like mousepads, buttons, and more!

[url=https://otusun.booth.pm/items/1943823][img]https://i.imgur.com/keWr4jc.jpg[/img][/url]

We're working on getting English descriptions added for the other products, but everything's available right now! Please note that currently the number of countries we can ship to is limited, but we are able to ship to the US and most major EU countries.
